# Design system starter

> Design system starter where design-system drift fails the build.

Import only from `src/index.ts`. Every export's props, variants, stories, tokens and usage rules: [design-system.manifest.json](design-system.manifest.json) ([schema](design-system.manifest.schema.json)). Every usage doc and guide in full: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt). Rules for all UI work:

```text
UI rules (design system v0)
- Style only with semantic tokens. No hex, rgb, px, ms or other raw values;
  allowed literals are inherit, currentColor, transparent, none, auto, 0, 1px, 100%.
- Compose system components and layout primitives, imported from src/index.ts.
  Never import radix-ui outside src/components or src/primitives, or
  react-aria-components and @internationalized/* outside src/components.
- Never restyle a system component with className or style. Need a new look?
  Propose a variant. UNSAFE_className / UNSAFE_style are escape hatches that need
  a lint disable with a reason, an owner and a removal condition.
- Before creating a component, walk the decision ladder: template → variant →
  component → primitive. Stop at the first yes.
- Missing token? Add a semantic token in tokens/ (with a dark value for colours),
  run npm run tokens. Never write a literal instead.
- New pages start from PageHeader (the one h1, status, actions) inside the right
  layout: AppShell for signed-in pages (fill its slots; never rebuild the frame),
  AuthLayout for signed-out pages, FocusedLayout for multi-step tasks; PageLayout
  for a page's sub-nav or aside. Copy the matching golden example: list → ListPage,
  record → RecordPage, create/edit → CreateEditFlow, settings → SettingsPage,
  sign-in → SignInPage, wizard → SetupWizard, dashboard → DashboardPage,
  error/404 → ErrorPages. Not other screens.
- Links go through Link (or Nav, NavTabs, Breadcrumbs); the app injects its router
  once with LinkProvider. NavTabs for sections that are routes, Tabs for panels in place.
- CSS: inside a declared @layer, BEM-lite classes, logical properties only,
  variants as closed data-* attributes, state via aria/native attributes,
  specificity ≤ 0,3,0, no !important, no ids.
- Every new variant, size or state gets a story. Every new exported component,
  layout or primitive gets a usage doc in docs/usage/<Name>.usage.tsx (when to
  use, when not to, do/don't, accessibility); tests/unit/docs.test.tsx fails
  without one. Lint, npm run check and the gallery (visual + axe + WCAG 2.2 checks) must pass.
- A story that renders an open modal is tagged ['modal-open', '!autodocs'].
- WCAG 2.2 AA is part of the gate: targets ≥ 24px or spaced (size.target-min),
  focus never hidden behind sticky content (scroll containers use
  space.scroll-padding.*), password fields as TextField type="password" with
  autoComplete (username, current-password or new-password, one-time-code),
  never block paste, pass AppShell's help from the shell composition, never
  ask twice in a multi-step flow, and any drag declares data-drag-alternative.
- Never add an eslint-disable or stylelint-disable without a reason after "--".
- Format every number, date, amount and list with useFormat() (LocaleProvider
  sets locale and time zone). Money is integer minor units + currency code.
- AI: render model output with StreamingText (never raw HTML), cite sources
  with Citation + SourcesList, mark unaccepted AI content with AiMarker, and
  never let AI write without ReviewChanges (or an explicit accept) and an Undo.
  The assistant acts only through the person's own can() and named mutations.
```

- [Colour](docs/foundations/Colour.stories.tsx): Every semantic colour role, in light and dark, with the contrast it…
- [Data visualisation](docs/foundations/DataVisualisation.stories.tsx): Colours for chart marks: a categorical palette for series, a…
- [Typography](docs/foundations/Typography.stories.tsx): Named text styles, each a complete font shorthand.
- [Spacing, sizing and radius](docs/foundations/SpacingSizingRadius.stories.tsx): Every length in the system comes from these scales.
- [Breakpoints and layout grid](docs/foundations/BreakpointsLayoutGrid.stories.tsx): Layouts respond to the space they are given, not to the device.
- [Elevation and motion](docs/foundations/ElevationMotion.stories.tsx): Shadows say how far a surface floats; stacking tokens say what sits…
- [Layers](docs/foundations/Layers.stories.tsx): Seven stacking tiers, lowest first.
- [Focus and target size](docs/foundations/FocusTargetSize.stories.tsx): Keyboard users need to see where they are; pointer and touch users…
- [Icons](docs/foundations/Icons.stories.tsx): A small, closed set drawn on one 20-unit grid with one stroke token.

## Components

- [Accordion](docs/usage/Accordion.usage.tsx): A stack of titled sections that open and close
- [AiMarker](docs/usage/AiMarker.usage.tsx): Marks content the AI wrote and a person hasn't accepted or…
- [Avatar](docs/usage/Avatar.usage.tsx): Showing who: record owners, activity authors
- [Badge](docs/usage/Badge.usage.tsx): A record’s status in a table row, title or card: a word plus a tone
- [Banner](docs/usage/Banner.usage.tsx): Ongoing state for a page or region
- [Breadcrumbs](docs/usage/Breadcrumbs.usage.tsx): Path back up a genuinely nested hierarchy
- [Button](docs/usage/Button.usage.tsx): To run an action on this page: save, create, delete, open a dialog
- [Card](docs/usage/Card.usage.tsx): A bounded surface for one titled block of a page
- [ChatThread](docs/usage/ChatThread.usage.tsx): The list of turns in a conversation
- [Checkbox](docs/usage/Checkbox.usage.tsx): An independent yes/no inside a form that is saved with the form
- [Citation](docs/usage/Citation.usage.tsx): A numbered inline citation, [1]
- [CodeBlock](docs/usage/CodeBlock.usage.tsx): Monospaced code in a keyboard-scrollable region
- [Combobox](docs/usage/Combobox.usage.tsx): A text field with a list of options that narrows as you type
- [CommandPalette](docs/usage/CommandPalette.usage.tsx): The command palette
- [Composer](docs/usage/Composer.usage.tsx): Where the person writes to the assistant
- [ContextMenu](docs/usage/ContextMenu.usage.tsx): Actions on a thing, where the pointer or focus is: right-click
- [CopyButton](docs/usage/CopyButton.usage.tsx): Copies a value to the clipboard
- [DatePicker](docs/usage/DatePicker.usage.tsx): A calendar date
- [Dialog](docs/usage/Dialog.usage.tsx): Modal dialog
- [Disclosure](docs/usage/Disclosure.usage.tsx): One section that shows and hides its details
- [Divider](docs/usage/Divider.usage.tsx): A hairline between blocks or inline groups
- [Drawer](docs/usage/Drawer.usage.tsx): Modal side sheet over a scrim
- [EmptyState](docs/usage/EmptyState.usage.tsx): What a list, table or panel shows instead of its content
- [Feedback](docs/usage/Feedback.usage.tsx): Thumbs up or down on one AI result
- [FileUpload](docs/usage/FileUpload.usage.tsx): Picks files with a button and, as an enhancement
- [Heading](docs/usage/Heading.usage.tsx): Page titles and section titles, in outline order
- [HoverCard](docs/usage/HoverCard.usage.tsx): A supplementary preview of a link's destination
- [InlineEdit](docs/usage/InlineEdit.usage.tsx): A value you can change where it's shown
- [Kbd](docs/usage/Kbd.usage.tsx): A key or a keyboard shortcut, shown as key caps
- [Link](docs/usage/Link.usage.tsx): An inline or standalone text link
- [Menu](docs/usage/Menu.usage.tsx): Action menu
- [Message](docs/usage/Message.usage.tsx): One turn in a ChatThread: a header, the content
- [Meter](docs/usage/Meter.usage.tsx): How much of a limit is used: seats, storage, API calls
- [MultiSelect](docs/usage/MultiSelect.usage.tsx): Choosing several values from a list that narrows as you type
- [Nav](docs/usage/Nav.usage.tsx): Vertical navigation: the app's primary sidebar or a section sub-nav
- [NavTabs](docs/usage/NavTabs.usage.tsx): Section navigation that looks like tabs but is links
- [NumberField](docs/usage/NumberField.usage.tsx): A number typed in the reader's own format
- [PageHeader](docs/usage/PageHeader.usage.tsx): The top of every page
- [Pagination](docs/usage/Pagination.usage.tsx): Moves through a long, server-paged list
- [Popover](docs/usage/Popover.usage.tsx): A small non-modal panel anchored to its trigger, for a few controls
- [Progress](docs/usage/Progress.usage.tsx): Determinate progress through a task
- [RadioGroup](docs/usage/RadioGroup.usage.tsx): One choice from a few visible options
- [ReviewChanges](docs/usage/ReviewChanges.usage.tsx): Changes an AI proposes, reviewed before anything happens
- [SearchField](docs/usage/SearchField.usage.tsx): A search input: type="search", a search icon
- [SegmentedControl](docs/usage/SegmentedControl.usage.tsx): One value from a few, always exactly one
- [Select](docs/usage/Select.usage.tsx): Single-choice list
- [Skeleton](docs/usage/Skeleton.usage.tsx): Placeholder for content on first load
- [Slider](docs/usage/Slider.usage.tsx): Picks a number, or a range
- [Spinner](docs/usage/Spinner.usage.tsx): Indeterminate progress for short or briefly unpredictable waits
- [Stat](docs/usage/Stat.usage.tsx): One headline number in a tile: label, value and an optional change
- [Stepper](docs/usage/Stepper.usage.tsx): Where someone is in an ordered task
- [StreamingText](docs/usage/StreamingText.usage.tsx): Text that arrives token by token
- [Suggestion](docs/usage/Suggestion.usage.tsx): A multi-line text field that can show an inline AI…
- [Switch](docs/usage/Switch.usage.tsx): An on/off setting that takes effect as a setting, not a form answer
- [Table](docs/usage/Table.usage.tsx): Data table: native table semantics, sticky header, tabular numbers
- [Tabs](docs/usage/Tabs.usage.tsx): Tabs: arrow-key roving focus and ARIA wiring come from Radix Tabs
- [Tag](docs/usage/Tag.usage.tsx): A compact value: an active filter chip, a label on a record
- [Text](docs/usage/Text.usage.tsx): Running text, descriptions and metadata
- [TextField](docs/usage/TextField.usage.tsx): Short free text: names, emails, amounts, search, passwords
- [Textarea](docs/usage/Textarea.usage.tsx): Multi-line text
- [Timeline](docs/usage/Timeline.usage.tsx): A dated list of events: a record's activity, an audit trail, a feed
- [Toast](docs/usage/Toast.usage.tsx): Declarative toast
- [Toggle](docs/usage/Toggle.usage.tsx): A button that stays pressed
- [Toolbar](docs/usage/Toolbar.usage.tsx): A row of related controls that is one tab stop
- [Tooltip](docs/usage/Tooltip.usage.tsx): Tooltip on hover and focus, dismissed with Escape

## Primitives

- [Box](docs/usage/Box.usage.tsx): Padding around content, from the inset scale
- [Center](docs/usage/Center.usage.tsx): Horizontally centred column with a bounded measure
- [Cluster](docs/usage/Cluster.usage.tsx): Horizontal group that wraps gracefully
- [Cover](docs/usage/Cover.usage.tsx): Vertically centres its content in the available block size
- [Frame](docs/usage/Frame.usage.tsx): Holds media to a fixed aspect ratio and crops it to fill
- [Grid](docs/usage/Grid.usage.tsx): Auto-fit card grid
- [Imposter](docs/usage/Imposter.usage.tsx): Positions an overlay over the centre of its container
- [Reel](docs/usage/Reel.usage.tsx): A single row that scrolls sideways
- [Sidebar](docs/usage/Sidebar.usage.tsx): Side region beside main content
- [Stack](docs/usage/Stack.usage.tsx): Vertical flow with consistent spacing
- [Switcher](docs/usage/Switcher.usage.tsx): A row of equal items that becomes a column, all at once
- [VisuallyHidden](docs/usage/VisuallyHidden.usage.tsx): Content that screen readers announce but the screen doesn't…

## Layouts

- [AppShell](docs/usage/AppShell.usage.tsx): The app frame every signed-in page renders inside
- [AssistantPanel](docs/usage/AssistantPanel.usage.tsx): The assistant beside the page, in AppShell's `assistant` slot
- [AuthLayout](docs/usage/AuthLayout.usage.tsx): The frame for signed-out pages
- [FocusedLayout](docs/usage/FocusedLayout.usage.tsx): The frame for a focused, multi-step task
- [PageLayout](docs/usage/PageLayout.usage.tsx): The regions of a page's body, below its PageHeader
- [SplitView](docs/usage/SplitView.usage.tsx): A list and the selected item side by side

## Utilities

- [LocaleProvider](docs/usage/LocaleProvider.usage.tsx): Sets the locale and time zone every system and app format reads
- [createFormatter](docs/usage/LocaleProvider.usage.tsx): Formats for one locale and time zone
- [currencyDigits](docs/usage/LocaleProvider.usage.tsx): Decimal places a currency's minor unit has: USD 2, JPY 0, BHD 3
- [useFormat](docs/usage/LocaleProvider.usage.tsx): The named formats for the current locale and time zone
- [vars](src/tokens/tokens.ts): Semantic and component tokens as var() references
